s: Which of the following is true about the PM-Vidyalaxmi scheme?
o: The scheme provides financial support only for students in government higher education institutions.
Students with an annual family income of up to 8 lakh are eligible for a 3% interest subvention on loans up to ₹10 lakh.
The scheme is only applicable to students who are pursuing non-technical courses.
Students applying for loan under PM-Vidyalaxmi must provide collateral and a guarantor.
x: PM-Vidyalaxmi gives a 3% interest subvention on loans up to ₹10 lakh to students with family income up to ₹8 lakh. The loans are collateral-free and guarantor-free, cover all courses at the 1,425 Quality HEIs, and include private institutions in the top 100 NIRF, so the other options are wrong.

s: Which initiative, launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi during India's 79th Independence Day celebrations in 2025, aims to boost employment generation while improving youth employability and social security?
o: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana
x: The PM announced the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana in his 79th Independence Day speech (15 Aug 2025): an employment-linked incentive (₹99,446 crore) for first-time employees and employers, aiming at 3.5 crore jobs via EPFO. 'PM Kaushal Rozgar' and 'PM Awas Rozgar' are not schemes; PMRY was a 1993 self-employment scheme.

s:
Consider the following statements about Garbhini-GA2:

I. It is the first India-specific Artificial Intelligence (AI) model which accurately determines the age of a fetus in pregnant women in the second and third trimesters.

II. Garbhini-GA2 was developed by the researchers at the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras and Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI), Faridabad.
Which among the above statements is/are correct?
x: Garbhini-GA2 is the first India-specific AI model that estimates foetal age in the second and third trimesters. It was built under GARBH-INi (DBT) by IIT Madras and THSTI, Faridabad, so both statements are correct.

s:
Match the items given in
List I with those in
List II.
List I (Service):
1. Avail Online LPG Services
2. Bharatgas: Voluntarily Surrender LPG Subsidy under 'GiveItUp' Movement
3. Indane: LPG Refill Booking and Online Payment
4. Indane: Apply for New LPG Domestic Connection with Online Payment
List II (Description):
A. Allows users to book an LPG refill and make payments online
B. Provides an online facility to book a double bottle LPG connection
C. Offers a platform to access various LPG-related services online
D. Encourages users to voluntarily give up their LPG subsidy to support government initiative
x: 'Avail Online LPG Services' is the general portal (C); 'GiveItUp' is voluntarily surrendering the subsidy (D); 'Refill Booking and Online Payment' is booking plus paying (A); and 'Apply for New Connection' leaves the double-bottle connection (B). So 1-C, 2-D, 3-A, 4-B.

s: The Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojna (PM-AJAY)'s objective is?
o: Reduce poverty of the Scheduled Caste community through skill development
Reduce poverty of the Scheduled Tribe community through skill development
Reduce poverty of the upper hill community through economic opportunities and development of infrastructure
Reduce poverty of the OBC community through skill development
x: PM-AJAY (Anusuchit Jaati = Scheduled Castes) aims to reduce poverty in SC communities through skill development, income-generating schemes and infrastructure in SC-majority villages (Adarsh Gram). It is not for STs, hill communities or OBCs.
